<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Open IMAP connections to each account one at a time until the server refuses one or 16 are open, then size the account's connection pool from the count. With no account, probe every account.

## Usage

```text
chainmail accounts probe [<account>]...
```

## Examples

```sh
# every account
chainmail accounts probe
chainmail accounts probe work gmail
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
